name: frontend-ai-workflow
description: Lightweight frontend delivery with project-grounded requirements, proportional design, implementation, and per-acceptance verification.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver frontend changes with bounded context and sufficient verification.
interface.longDescription: Build project-grounded requirements, approach, implementation, and per-acceptance verification through Direct or Light delivery without management files; use bundled OpenSpec 1.9 for one traceable Complex change, and keep testing, UI review, initialization, health checks, and upgrades explicit.
defaultPrompt: Implement this frontend change from project-grounded requirements through per-acceptance verification.
Initialize this frontend repository with the lightweight shared workflow.
Run an explicit frontend test or UI verification task without changing unrelated product code.
